**CLAIM** — session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`, branch `claude/issue-4432-dashboard-grid-whitelist`.

**Ruling**: migration step 2 under the #4425 phase-2 whitelist contract, following #4431's landed shape (PR #4485): consume `toDomProps`/`pickDomProps` from `@object-ui/core` (no new dependency — plugin-dashboard already declares core), convert `DashboardRenderer`'s widget grid container to consume-or-whitelist, delete its ledger row in the same PR. Red-first = the ratchet both ways (13-attribute leak verbatim pre-fix; stale-row red post-fix with the row retained; green after deletion) plus a #4485-style exact-set pin on the container's attribute set, rendered through SchemaRenderer WITH an adapter attached (the #4428 lesson).

**Also in scope (routed here from PR #4485's review)**: the sweep file's header reading table still says `plugin-chatbot | 3 | 2 | 14 each` and "5 of 23 targets leak" — both now false. Your ledger edit already opens that file: bring the header table to current truth for BOTH packages (after your fix: chatbot 0, dashboard 0 or whatever remains — state what the ledger then holds; metric/metric-card rows are #4425's own subject, do not touch their rows).

**Watch for the #4485 disabled-precedent**: if the grid container's old spread was silently overriding any computed prop (the `disabled` shape #4485 measured on chatbot), consume the injected verdict rather than re-reading raw schema — one carrier — and name every behavior edge that moves in the PR body.

**Sequencing gate**: PR #4485 must be in `origin/main` before you branch (it is armed, CI green — poll `git fetch origin main && git log origin/main --oneline` every ~180s, ≤40min; report BLOCKED if it doesn't land).

**Grading**: patch `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` (behavior-only expected); `.d.ts`-checked both ways; never major.

**Surface (mutual exclusion)**: `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardRenderer.tsx` (or wherever measurement places the grid spread) + its new pin test + the ledger row deletion & header-table truth-up in `packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/widget-dom-leak-sweep.test.tsx` + one changeset. ⛔ NOT: `packages/core`/`packages/fields` (landed by #4485), chatbot, MetricWidget/`metric` rows (#4425's subject), plugin-calendar, `console/organizations/**`, ObjectView, ListView, `content/docs/releases/`. Disjoint from in-flight #4462/#4474/#4336/#4408.
